Translation: 保存设置：保存到原来保存的设置中，或使用新名称

English: The setup has changes that are not saved: save it into the saved setup it came from, or under a new name
Translation: 设置有未保存的更改：将其保存到原来保存的设置中，或以新名称保存

Translation: 另存为新、重命名、删除或开始新设置

Translation: 立即开始游戏（首先编写您的规则），尚未加载比赛

Translation: 比赛的地图、阵容、规则、模式和高级选项

Translation: 与您的比赛一起运行专用服务器，或控制另一台电脑上的服务器

Translation: 控制正在进行的比赛：回合、规则、机器人、作弊和控制台命令

Translation: 游戏文件夹、控制台键、启动选项

English: Copy the console command, if you ever want to paste it yourself
Translation: 如果您想自己粘贴，请复制控制台命令

Translation: 打开带有已清理报告的设置，以便在发送任何内容之前进行检查

English: For maps the launcher can't read. The mod page usually lists the level and scenario names.
Translation: 对于启动器无法读取的地图。 Mod 页面通常会列出关卡和场景名称。

Translation: 游戏模式（用于机器人和规则设置）

English: Leave empty to guess it from the scenario name.
Translation: 留空可以从场景名称中猜测。

English: Co-op (PvE): play it solo or with AI teammates
Translation: 合作 (PvE)：单独玩或与 AI 队友一起玩

Translation: 对战（PvP）：离线时你可以与机器人对战

English: Teammates, enemies and AI difficulty, with presets
Translation: 队友、敌人和AI难度，都有预设

English: Every match setting of the selected game mode, with presets
Translation: 所选游戏模式的每场比赛设置，带有预设

English: Mutators for the match (official and from mods) and the mods the game has installed
Translation: 比赛的变异器（官方和来自模组）以及游戏已安装的模组

Translation: 规则集、额外的 Game.ini 行、加载后的命令

Translation: 随机选择一张地图和场景（与当前场景相同）

Translation: 按级别和场景名称添加地图

English: Put every setting of this game mode back to the game default
Translation: 将此游戏模式的所有设置恢复为游戏默认值

English: No maps yet. Make sure the game folder is set in Settings.
Translation: 还没有地图。确保在“设置”中设置了游戏文件夹。

English: Hardcore Checkpoint: no HUD, more damage, limited respawns (Checkpoint scenarios only)
Translation: 硬核检查点：无 HUD、更多伤害、有限重生（仅限检查点场景）

English: MaxPlayers · raised automatically to fit AI teammates
Translation: MaxPlayers · 自动提高以适应 AI 队友

English: Bots on your team. Read at game start (the launcher restarts it if needed).
Translation: 您团队中的机器人。在游戏开始时读取（如果需要，启动器会重新启动）。

English: Enemy bots alive at once when you are the only human player
Translation: 当你是唯一的人类玩家时，敌人的机器人会立即存活

English: Fewest enemy bots with a group of players
Translation: 一群玩家的敌人机器人数量最少

English: Most enemy bots with a full group of players
Translation: 大多数敌方机器人都拥有完整的玩家群体

English: Size of each team. You take one slot on yours; bots fill the rest and the whole enemy team.
Translation: 每个团队的规模。您占据自己的一个位置；机器人占据了剩下的人和整个敌方队伍。

English: How well bots aim, spot and react. 0.5 is the game default.
Translation: 机器人瞄准、发现和反应的能力如何。 0.5是游戏默认值。

English: Versus: set after the map loads, as a console command the game runs as if you typed it (sent over RCON, nothing is typed).
Translation: 对比：在地图加载后设置，作为控制台命令，游戏运行就像您键入它一样（通过 RCON 发送，不键入任何内容）。

English: mode. Gold = changed from the game default. Bots and enemies are on the Squad tab.
Translation: 模式。金币=更改了游戏默认值。机器人和敌人位于“小队”选项卡上。

English: One click sets many rules. The next preset takes the last one's rules and mutators back out.
Translation: 一键设置许多规则。下一个预设将取消上一个预设的规则和变异器。

English: The official online playlists: their mutators and rules, added to the map you picked
Translation: 官方在线播放列表：它们的变异器和规则，已添加到您选择的地图中
搜索预设（名称、变异器、模式）
游戏开始时的官方规则

English: Starts the game with -ruleset= like the official playlist. Needs a game start.
Translation: 像官方播放列表一样使用 -ruleset= 开始游戏。需要游戏开始。

English: Replace keeps only the launcher's rules and these lines.
Translation: 替换仅保留启动器的规则和这些行。

English: Insert the settings section of an active mutator:
Translation: 插入活动突变器的设置部分：

English:
One console command per line, e.g.
SetRoundTimer 1800
Translation:
每行一个控制台命令，例如
设置循环定时器 1800
额外的选项，例如?回合时间=900

English: Added to the end of the open command.
Translation: 添加到打开命令的末尾。

English: Load the map twice (for mods that only work after a second load)
Translation: 加载地图两次（对于仅在第二次加载后才起作用的模组）

English: Game.ini block (other lines in your Game.ini are kept)
Translation: Game.ini 块（Game.ini 中的其他行保留）

English: Map, mode, side, day or night
Translation: 地图、模式、侧面、白天或夜间

English: Every match setting, presets and playlists
Translation: 每场比赛设置、预设和播放列表

English: Pick mutators and their load order
Translation: 选择变异器及其加载顺序

English: Turn off to play without mutators but keep your selection
Translation: 关闭以在没有突变器的情况下进行游戏，但保留您的选择

English: Keep everything (map, scenario, bots, rules, mutators, Advanced) as a saved setup. Pick it again in the bar at the top.
Translation: 将所有内容（地图、场景、机器人、规则、变异器、高级）保留为已保存的设置。在顶部的栏中再次选择它。

English: Bots, enemies, every rule and the mutators back to the game defaults (map stays)
Translation: 机器人、敌人、每条规则和变异器回到游戏默认值（地图保持不变）

English: Control the match that is running
Works once you are in a match.
Translation: 一旦你参加比赛就起作用。

English: Set directly over RCON (nothing typed). Lasts until the map changes. Empty = keep the current value.
Translation: 直接通过 RCON 设置（无需输入任何内容）。持续到地图改变为止。清空=保持当前值。

English: The editable values appear here once a match is running.
Translation: 比赛开始后，可编辑的值就会出现在此处。

English: Restart the round so every change applies
Translation: 重新开始回合，以便所有更改都适用

English: Any console command. The game runs it as if you typed it into its console, but it is sent over RCON, so nothing is typed and the game can stay in the background. Join several with |.
Translation: 任何控制台命令。游戏会像您在控制台中输入一样运行它，但它是通过 RCON 发送的，因此无需输入任何内容，游戏可以停留在后台。用 | 连接多个。

English: Click one to put it in the console box.
Translation: 单击其中一个将其放入控制台框中。

English: Tick mutators to load them with the match.
Translation: 勾选变异器以将其与匹配项一起加载。

English: Search name, ID, mod or description
Look for new or updated mods
Translation: 寻找新的或更新的模组

English: Parent classes other mutators build on. They do nothing alone.
Translation: 其他变异器构建的父类。他们独自什么也不做。

English: The mod does not register this folder for mutators, so the game may not find it.
Translation: 该模组不会为变异器注册此文件夹，因此游戏可能找不到它。

English: Tick mutators on the left. Order here = load order.
Translation: 勾选左侧的突变体。此处订购 = 加载订单。

English: Type a mutator ID the launcher can't see.
Translation: 输入启动器看不到的变异器 ID。

English: Mods the game has downloaded. Subscribe in the game's mod menu.
Translation: 游戏已下载模组。在游戏的模组菜单中订阅。
场景（可在播放页面播放）

English: No mods yet. Subscribe in the game, start it once, then Rescan.
Translation: 还没有模组。在游戏中订阅，启动一次，然后重新扫描。

English: Host your match for other players
The dedicated server is free. The launcher installs it with SteamCMD, Valve's own tool: about 5 GB is downloaded into the folder below.
Translation: 专用服务器是免费的。启动器使用 Valve 自己的工具 SteamCMD 来安装它：大约 5 GB 下载到下面的文件夹中。

English: Downloads SteamCMD from Valve and installs the server (Steam app 581330)
Translation: 从 Valve 下载 SteamCMD 并安装服务器（Steam 应用程序 581330）

English: I have it: pick its folder...
Translation: 我有它：选择它的文件夹...

English: Gets the newest server with SteamCMD (players can only join a server of the same version as their game)
Translation: 通过SteamCMD获取最新服务器（玩家只能加入与游戏版本相同的服务器）

English: SteamCMD checks every file and fetches the broken ones
Translation: SteamCMD 检查每个文件并获取损坏的文件

English: Installed with Steam (Library > Tools): Steam keeps it up to date.
Translation: 与 Steam 一起安装（库 > 工具）：Steam 保持最新状态。

English: Writes the server's settings and starts it with your match from Play
Translation: 写入服务器的设置并从 Play 中开始比赛

English: Stops the server and starts it again with the match and settings on this page
Translation: 停止服务器并使用此页面上的匹配和设置重新启动它

English: Over RCON you control the players, the chat, the map and the rules. Starting and stopping the server and its files need the server on this PC.
Translation: 通过 RCON，您可以控制玩家、聊天、地图和规则。启动和停止服务器及其文件需要此 PC 上的服务器。

English: Used the next time the server starts.
Translation: 下次服务器启动时使用。

English: The options from your .bat file, used as they are. The launcher adds only a waiting mod.io code, and its RCON to Game.ini when you have none.
Translation: .bat 文件中的选项按原样使用。启动器仅将等待的 mod.io 代码及其 RCON 添加到 Game.ini（当您没有代码时）。

English: Reads the line of your .bat file that starts InsurgencyServer
Translation: 读取启动 InsurgencyServer 的 .bat 文件行

English: The settings below, the map cycle, the admins and the Play match are not used while this is on.
Translation: 开启此功能后，不会使用以下设置、地图周期、管理员和比赛比赛。

English: Start the server with the options of your own .bat file
Translation: 使用您自己的 .bat 文件的选项启动服务器
服务器浏览器中的名称

English: Players on the internet need both ports open in your firewall and forwarded by your router.
Translation: 互联网上的玩家需要在防火墙中打开两个端口并由路由器转发。
显示服务器的日志窗口

English: The server's own window with its live log (-log).
Translation: 服务器自己的窗口及其实时日志（-log）。

English: For testing: cheat commands work on this server, and players earn no XP (-EnableCheats).
Translation: 用于测试：作弊命令在此服务器上有效，并且玩家不会获得 XP（-EnableCheats）。

English: A player calls the vote from the Esc menu; F1 votes yes, F2 no. It needs at least 3 players.
Translation: 玩家通过 Esc 菜单进行投票； F1 投赞成票，F2 投反对票。至少需要3名玩家。

English: Listed under the server browser's official rules filter; the server keeps the official values (-ruleset=OfficialRules).
Translation: 列在服务器浏览器的官方规则过滤器下；服务器保留官方值（-ruleset=OfficialRules）。

English: Players earn XP and stats here (needs the token and no join password).
Translation: 玩家可以在这里获得 XP 和统计数据（需要令牌且无需加入密码）。

English: from gamestats.sandstorm.game, sign in with Steam
Translation: 从 gamestats.sandstorm.game，使用 Steam 登录

English: added to the end of the server's command line
Translation: 添加到服务器命令行的末尾

English: Players type this into the game's console, or find the server under LAN in the server browser.
Translation: 玩家在游戏控制台中输入此内容，或在服务器浏览器中找到 LAN 下的服务器。

English: The launcher controls the server through its RCON, set up in the server's Game.ini with a random password. Other RCON tools work with the same port and password.
Translation: 启动器通过 RCON 控制服务器，RCON 在服务器的 Game.ini 中使用随机密码进行设置。其他 RCON 工具使用相同的端口和密码。
允许来自其他 PC 的 RCON

English: Off: only this PC can connect. On: every network card listens; your firewall must let the port through, and 5 wrong passwords lock an address out for 30 minutes.
Translation: 熄灭：只有该电脑可以连接。亮：各网卡监听；您的防火墙必须允许该端口通过，并且 5 次错误的密码会将某个地址锁定 30 分钟。

English: Steam IDs (the 17-digit number starting with 7656119), one per line. Admins open the admin menu in the game (Keypad -) to kick, ban and change the map.
Translation: Steam ID（以 7656119 开头的 17 位数字），每行一个。管理员打开游戏中的管理菜单（键盘-）即可踢出、禁止和更改地图。

English: Players see it while they join: your rules, a Discord link. Saved as Motd.txt when the server starts; an empty box removes the file.
Translation: 玩家在加入时会看到：您的规则、Discord 链接。服务器启动时保存为Motd.txt；空框将删除该文件。

English: e.g. No team killing. Discord: discord.gg/...
Translation: 例如没有团队杀戮。不和谐：discord.gg/...

English: Updates per second, 10 to 240 (NetServerMaxTickRate in the server's Engine.ini). The game uses 64; 128 is smoother and needs more CPU. Empty leaves Engine.ini as it is.
Translation: 每秒更新次数，10 到 240（服务器 Engine.ini 中的 NetServerMaxTickRate）。游戏使用64； 128更流畅，需要更多CPU。清空后，Engine.ini 保持原样。

English: Restart the server if it closes
Translation: 如果服务器关闭，请重新启动服务器

English: Starts it again 10 seconds after it closes without Stop (a crash), at most 3 times in 15 minutes. The launcher has to stay open.
Translation: 关闭后10秒再次启动而不停止（崩溃），15分钟内最多启动3次。启动器必须保持打开状态。

English: The server downloads its mods from mod.io when it starts (-Mods), then loads your match again.
Translation: 服务器启动时会从 mod.io 下载模组 (-Mods)，然后再次加载您的比赛。
服务器的 mod.io 登录

English: The server needs a mod.io account of its own, not the one you play with (make one on mod.io with another e-mail). It logs in once with a code mod.io e-mails to that account.
Translation: 服务器需要一个自己的 mod.io 帐户，而不是您玩游戏时使用的帐户（使用另一封电子邮件在 mod.io 上创建一个帐户）。它使用代码登录一次，mod.io 会向该帐户发送电子邮件。

English: E-mail of the server's mod.io account
Translation: 服务器 mod.io 帐户的电子邮件

English: mod.io e-mails a 5-digit security code to this address
Translation: mod.io 通过电子邮件将 5 位安全代码发送到此地址

English: Mods for the server (mod.io ids, one per line)
Translation: 服务器 Mod（mod.io id，每行一个）

English: The server loads the mods its account is subscribed to. Subscribe subscribes it to this list; players need the same mods.
Translation: 服务器加载其帐户订阅的模组。订阅将其订阅到此列表；玩家需要相同的模组。

English: Subscribes the server's mod.io account to every mod on the list (needs the server logged in)
Translation: 将服务器的 mod.io 帐户订阅列表中的每个 mod（需要服务器登录）

English: Adds the mod ids of a Mods.txt to the list
Translation: 将 Mods.txt 的 mod id 添加到列表中

English: Log in there with the server's account to see or change its subscriptions
Translation: 使用服务器帐户登录以查看或更改其订阅

English: Unsubscribes the server's account from the mods that are not on the list
Translation: 取消服务器帐户对不在列表中的模组的订阅
正在运行的服务器上的 Mod

English: Reads the server's own log to see whether it logged in to mod.io and loaded the mods
Translation: 读取服务器自己的日志，查看是否登录了mod.io并加载了mod

English: Sets up the match in Play, the map cycle and the number of players in one go, like the official servers. Change anything afterwards.
Translation: 与官方服务器一样，一次性设置Play中的比赛、地图周期和玩家数量。事后改变什么。

English: Install the server first (on the left).
Day and night maps in the map cycle
Translation: 地图循环中的日夜地图

English: Sets up the match in Play, the map cycle and the players for this kind of server
Translation: 设置游戏中的比赛、地图周期和此类服务器的玩家

English: The server starts with your match from Play: map, scenario, lighting, rules, bots and mutators.
Translation: 服务器从 Play 中的比赛开始：地图、场景、灯光、规则、机器人和变异器。

English: Use the rules in the server's Game.ini
Translation: 使用服务器 Game.ini 中的规则

English: Rules, bots and AI teammates stay as you set them in the server's Game.ini. Play gives only the map, scenario, lighting and mutators.
Translation: 规则、机器人和 AI 队友会保留在服务器 Game.ini 中设置的内容。游戏只提供地图、场景、灯光和变异器。

English: The server plays these one after another. Off: it goes through the game's versus scenarios.
Translation: 服务器会依次播放这些内容。关闭：它会经历游戏的对抗场景。

English: Any MapCycle.txt; the server gets a copy in its Config\Server folder when it starts
Translation: 任何 MapCycle.txt；服务器启动时会在其 Config\Server 文件夹中获取一个副本

English: Adds the scenario, lighting and mode picked in Play
Translation: 添加 Play 中选择的场景、灯光和模式

English: No scenarios yet. Set up a match in Play and press Add the Play match.
Translation: 还没有场景。在“比赛”中设置一场比赛，然后按“添加比赛”。

English: Live control of the running server over RCON.
Translation: 通过 RCON 对正在运行的服务器进行实时控制。

English: No players on the server (or it is not running).
Translation: 服务器上没有玩家（或者服务器没有运行）。

English: one chat message per line, sent in turn
Translation: 每行一条聊天消息，依次发送

English: minutes while the launcher is open (empty = off)
Translation: 启动器打开的分钟数（空=关闭）

English: Changes the running server to the match set up in Play
Translation: 将正在运行的服务器更改为 Play 中设置的比赛
例如列出游戏模式属性 bBot

English: What the launcher runs. Copy it to start the server your own way, e.g. from a .bat file or a server host's panel (its files are written when you press Start here).
Translation: 启动器运行什么。复制它以您自己的方式启动服务器，例如从 .bat 文件或服务器主机的面板（当您在此处按“开始”时写入其文件）。
管理员和地图周期文件夹

English: Game folder, game connection and launch options
Translation: 游戏文件夹、游戏连接和启动选项

English: Game files are never changed, only Game.ini and Input.ini (backed up).
Translation: 游戏文件永远不会改变，只有Game.ini和Input.ini（备份）。

English: The launcher loads maps, changes rules and sends console commands (cheats too) through the game's own remote console, on this PC only (127.0.0.1, random password). No keys are pressed and the game does not need to be in front.
Translation: 启动器加载地图、更改规则并通过游戏自己的远程控制台发送控制台命令（也作弊），仅在此 PC 上（127.0.0.1，随机密码）。无需按下任何按键，游戏也无需在前面。

English: Type into the game console when RCON is not available
Translation: 当 RCON 不可用时在游戏控制台中输入

English: Only for a game the launcher cannot reach over RCON, e.g. one started before the launcher set RCON up. Needs the game in front.
Translation: 仅对于启动器无法越过 RCON 的游戏，例如一个在启动器设置 RCON 之前启动。需要前面的游戏。

English: Only used when the game cannot be reached over RCON (see above). Nothing is typed unless the console is seen open.
Translation: 仅当无法通过 RCON 访问游戏时使用（见上文）。除非看到控制台打开，否则不会键入任何内容。

English: Add F10 as a console key automatically
Translation: 自动添加 F10 作为控制台键

English: Works on every keyboard layout, unlike the ` key.
Translation: 适用于所有键盘布局，与 ` 键不同。

English: Raise this if commands arrive cut off on a slow PC

English: Fight fast enemies who only attack with melee and Molotovs. Bullets can only deal damage to the head.
Translation: 与只用近战和燃烧弹攻击的快速敌人作战。子弹只能对头部造成伤害。

English: Capture and destroy objectives one at a time as you progress through the map on Hillside, a classic level from Insurgency 2014, in Frenzy Checkpoint.
Translation: 在《疯狂检查站》的《叛乱 2014》中的经典关卡《Hillside》中，在地图上前进时，一次占领并摧毁一个目标。

English: Fight elite enemies with a limited HUD, limited equipment, and slower movement speed.
Translation: 用有限的HUD、有限的装备和较慢的移动速度与精英敌人作战。

English: Capture and destroy objectives one at a time as you progress through the map on Hillside, a classic level from Insurgency 2014, in Hardcore Checkpoint.
Translation: 当您在 Hillside 地图上前进时，一次占领并摧毁一个目标，Hillside 是《Hardcore Checkpoint》中《Insurgency 2014》的经典关卡。

English: Capture and destroy objectives one at a time as you move through the area on snowy mountain map Hillside.
Translation: 当您穿过雪山地图 Hillside 上的区域时，一次占领并摧毁一个目标。

English: Hardcore, but everyone dies in one shot.
Translation: 硬核，但所有人都一枪毙命。

English: Capture and destroy objectives one at a time as you move through the area. Make do with fewer supply points.
Translation: 当你穿过该区域时，一次占领并摧毁一个目标。凑合使用较少的补给点。

English: Hardcore, but fewer calories. Experience Checkpoint mode with slower more tactical movement.
Translation: 硬核，但卡路里更少。体验检查站模式，速度更慢，更具战术性。

English: Enemies drop grenades on death. Get a headshot to prevent their grenade from dropping.
Translation: 敌人死亡时会投掷手榴弹。爆头以防止他们的手榴弹掉落。

English: Fight fast enemies who only attack with melee and Molotovs. Everyone who dies drops a live grenade.
Translation: 与只用近战和燃烧弹攻击的快速敌人作战。每个死去的人都会投下一颗未爆炸的手榴弹。

English: Capture and destroy objectives one at a time as you move through the area using light machine guns.
Translation: 当您使用轻机枪穿过该区域时，一次捕获并摧毁一个目标。

English: Start with a Makarov. Scavenge weapons from the enemy, and tap Use at supply crates to grab ammo.
Translation: 从马卡洛夫开始。从敌人身上搜刮武器，然后点击补给箱处的“使用”来获取弹药。

English: Hold your ground against waves of enemies. Gain supply points after each wave.
Translation: 坚守阵地，抵御一波又一波的敌人。每波之后获得补给点。

English: Hold off the hordes with guns from the back of the closet.
Translation: 用柜子后面的枪抵挡人群。

English: New support for Outpost mode on Tideway, Hideout, and Farmhouse maps.
Translation: 新支持 Tideway、Hideout 和 Farmhouse 地图上的前哨模式。

English: Improved Tell, Crossing, Ministry, and Hillside maps with better AI spawns and objective layouts.
Translation: 改进了 Tell、Crossing、Ministry 和 Hillside 地图，具有更好的 AI 生成和目标布局。

English: New support for Outpost mode on Summit, Precinct, and Refinery maps.
Translation: 新支持峰会、辖区和炼油厂地图上的前哨模式。

English: Capture and destroy objectives one at a time as you move through the area using pistols.
Translation: 当你使用手枪穿过该区域时，一次占领并摧毁一个目标。

English: Move fast, soak hits, don’t aim, and experience Sandstorm co-op with a late 90s FPS twist.
Translation: 快速移动、承受打击、不瞄准，体验带有 90 年代末 FPS 风格的沙尘暴合作游戏。

English: Stay on the move and survive until extraction. Secure objective locations stashed with random weapons.
Translation: 保持移动并生存直至撤离。用随机武器保护目标位置。

English: Fight the Frenzied as a tactical team of special forces vampires.
Translation: 扮演一支由吸血鬼特种部队组成的战术小队，与狂热分子作战。

English: Hardcore, but everyone dies in one shot and you need to earn all your supply points.
Translation: 硬核，但每个人都会一枪毙命，你需要赢得所有补给点。

English: Hilly rural combat in a rugged snowy environment in Checkpoint and Outpost modes.
Translation: 在检查站和前哨模式下，在崎岖的雪地环境中进行丘陵乡村战斗。

English: Hilly rural combat in a rugged snowy environment in Hardcore Checkpoint mode.
Translation: 在硬核检查点模式下，在崎岖的雪地环境中进行丘陵乡村战斗。

English: Hilly rural combat in a rugged snowy environment in various Versus modes.
Translation: 在崎岖的雪地环境中以各种对战模式进行丘陵乡村战斗。

English: Fight through an ancient structure and abandoned museum in Checkpoint, Outpost, and Survival modes.
Translation: 在检查站、前哨站和生存模式中穿过古老的建筑和废弃的博物馆。

English: Fight through an ancient structure and abandoned museum in various Versus modes.
Translation: 在各种对战模式中，穿越古老的建筑和废弃的博物馆。

English: Help test new features and levels with other members of the community.
Translation: 帮助与社区其他成员一起测试新功能和级别。

English: Fight through an airbase in the heart of a dense forest in various Coop modes.
Translation: 在各种合作模式中，在茂密森林中心的空军基地中作战。

English: Fight through an airbase in the heart of a dense forest in various Versus modes.
Translation: 在各种对战模式中，穿过茂密森林中心的空军基地。

English: Fight through a luxury hotel halls and impovrished slums in Checkpoint, Outpost, and Survival.
Translation: 在“检查站”、“前哨站”和“生存”中穿过豪华酒店大厅和贫困贫民窟。

English: Fight through a luxury hotel halls and impovrished slums in Push, Firefight, Domination, and our new Ambush mode.
Translation: 在推进、交火、统治和我们新的伏击模式中，穿过豪华酒店大厅和贫困贫民窟。

English: Fight through the ravaged floors of a besieged police station and its surrounding area in various Coop modes.
Translation: 在各种合作模式中，在被围困的警察局及其周边地区的被毁坏的地板上战斗。

English: Fight through the ravaged floors of a besieged police station and its surrounding area in various Versus modes.
Translation: 在各种对战模式中，在被围困的警察局及其周边地区的被毁坏的地板上进行战斗。

English: Fight through the narrow streets of a coastal town in various Coop modes.
Translation: 在各种合作模式中，在沿海小镇的狭窄街道上战斗。

English: Fight through the narrow streets of a coastal town in various Versus modes.
Translation: 在各种对战模式中，在沿海小镇的狭窄街道上战斗。
各种地图上的伏击模式

English: Domination mode on Precinct, Refinery, Outskirts, and Summit.
Translation: 辖区、炼油厂、郊区和山顶的统治模式。

English: Night versions of all levels in Normal co-op.
Translation: 普通合作模式中所有级别的夜间版本。

English: Night versions of all levels in Frenzy co-op.
Translation: 疯狂合作模式中所有级别的夜间版本。

English: Night versions of all levels in Hardcore co-op.
Translation: 硬核合作模式中所有级别的夜间版本。

English: Green vegetation and industrial themed map in Normal co-op.
Translation: 普通合作社中的绿色植被和工业主题地图。

English: New green vegetation and industrial themed map in Frenzy co-op.
Translation: 疯狂合作社中的新绿色植被和工业主题地图。

English: New green vegetation and industrial themed map in Hardcore co-op.
Translation: 硬核合作社中的新绿色植被和工业主题地图。

English: Green vegetation and industrial themed map on Push, Firefight, and Domination modes.
Translation: 绿色植被和工业主题地图的推动、交火和统治模式。

English: Fight through prison bars and constraining hallways in various Coop modes
Translation: 在各种合作模式下穿过监狱酒吧和狭窄的走廊

English: Fight through prison bars and constraining hallways in various Versus modes
Translation: 在各种对战模式中穿过监狱铁栅和狭窄的走廊

English: Tight urban CQB reimagining of a classic Insurgency 2014 map in normal co-op.
Translation: 严格的城市 CQB 重新设计了正常合作模式下的经典 Insurgency 2014 地图。

English: Tight urban CQB reimagining of a classic Insurgency 2014 map in Frenzy co-op.
Translation: 严格的城市 CQB 重新构想了 Frenzy 合作模式中的经典 Insurgency 2014 地图。

English: Tight urban CQB reimagining of a classic Insurgency 2014 map on Hardcore Checkpoint.
Translation: 严格的城市 CQB 重新构想了 Hardcore Checkpoint 上的经典 Insurgency 2014 地图。

English: Tight urban CQB reimagining of a classic Insurgency 2014 map on various Versus modes.
Translation: 严格的城市 CQB 在各种对战模式下重新构想了经典的 Insurgency 2014 地图。

English: Reimagining of desert level Buhriz from Insurgency 2014 in Normal co-op.
Translation: 在普通合作模式中重新构想《2014 年叛乱》中的沙漠关卡布赫里兹 (Buhriz)。

English: Reimagining of desert level Buhriz from Insurgency 2014 in Frenzy co-op.
Translation: 在疯狂合作模式中重新构想《叛乱 2014》中的沙漠关卡布赫里兹 (Buhriz)。

English: Reimagining of desert level Buhriz from Insurgency 2014 in Hardcore co-op.
Translation: 在硬核合作模式中重新构想《Insurgency 2014》中的沙漠关卡 Buhriz。

English: Reimagining of desert level Buhriz from Insurgency 2014 on various Versus modes.
Translation: 在各种对战模式下重新构想《Insurgency 2014》中的沙漠关卡 Buhriz。

English: Fight through an abandoned trainyard in the middle of the desert in various Coop modes.
Translation: 在各种合作模式中，在沙漠中部的废弃火车站中战斗。

English: Fight through an abandoned trainyard in the middle of the desert in various Versus modes.
Translation: 在各种对战模式中，穿越沙漠中部的废弃火车站。

English: Single-life elimination. The extracting team needs to escort the VIP to an objective. The ambushing team needs to eliminate the VIP.
Translation: 单一生命淘汰。撤离小组需要护送 VIP 到达目标。伏击队需要消灭重要人物。

English: Attack or defend the line. Take one objective at a time.
Translation: 攻击或防守防线。一次只设定一个目标。

English: Attack or defend the line. Take one objective at a time using anti-materiel rifles.
Translation: 攻击或防守防线。使用反器材步枪一次瞄准一个目标。

English: Attack or defend the line. Take one objective at a time using bolt-action weapons.
Translation: 攻击或防守防线。使用栓动武器一次完成一个目标。

English: Attack or defend the line with slower movement speed and slower capture speed. Take one objective at a time.
Translation: 以较慢的移动速度和较慢的捕获速度攻击或防守线路。一次只设定一个目标。

English: Attack or defend the line and take one objective at a time on snowy mountain map Hillside.
Translation: 在雪山地图 Hillside 上进攻或防守阵线，一次只取得一个目标。

English: Take territory and eliminate the enemy under the moonlight. Don't forget your night equipment.
Translation: 在月光下占领领土并消灭敌人。不要忘记您的夜间装备。

English: Start with low supply, and gain more as your score increases. Objective captures give the most supply.
Translation: 从少量供应开始，随着分数的增加而获得更多。客观捕获提供了最多的供应。

English: Kill the enemy more than they kill you with whatever weapons you like. Earn supply points as your score increases.
Translation: 用你喜欢的任何武器杀死敌人比他们杀死你还要多。随着分数的增加赚取补给点。

English: Only headshots, knives, and explosives will kill. Learn to juke and protect your dome.
Translation: 只有爆头、刀子和炸药才能杀人。学习变戏法并保护你的圆顶。

English: Secure the area. Take all objectives and hold them. Bullets can only deal damage to the head.
Translation: 确保该区域安全。采取并坚持所有目标。子弹只能对头部造成伤害。

English: Secure the area. Take all objectives and hold them.
Translation: 确保该区域安全。采取并坚持所有目标。

English: Get in close, but be careful. Corpses explode.
Translation: 靠近一点，但要小心。尸体爆炸。

English: Insurgents must destroy all the objectives by planting timed explosives. Security must defend the objectives and defuse planted explosives until the time runs out. Spawns are unlimited.
Translation: 叛乱分子必须通过放置定时炸药来摧毁所有目标。安全部门必须捍卫目标并拆除埋设的爆炸物，直到时间耗尽。生成次数是无限的。

English: Capture and hold all objectives. You will gain more score the more objectives your team owns.
Translation: 捕获并保持所有目标。您的团队拥有的目标越多，您将获得的分数越高。

English: High-stakes tactical engagements. Capture and defend all objectives. You only respawn when your team captures an objective.
Translation: 高风险的战术交战。占领并保卫所有目标。只有当你的团队夺取目标时，你才会重生。

English: Capture all objectives or eliminate all enemy players to win using pistols that kill in one shot.
Translation: 使用一枪毙命的手枪占领所有目标或消灭所有敌方玩家即可获胜。

English: Move the line forward, reach the enemy weapon cache, and destroy it. Don’t let the enemy get to yours. Player waves will slowly drain while their cache is exposed.
Translation: 向前移动队伍，到达敌人的武器储藏处，并将其摧毁。不要让敌人接近你。当玩家的缓存暴露时，玩家的波浪会慢慢耗尽。

English: Pistol wielding attackers advance through the map while defending pistol people try to stop them.
Translation: 持手枪的攻击者在地图上前进，而持手枪的人则试图阻止他们。

English: Kill the enemy more than they kill you with a big stinkin' revolver. And explosives.
Translation: 杀死敌人比他们用大而臭的左轮手枪杀死你还要多。还有炸药。

English: Use your Makarov, knife, and explosives to capture and hold all objectives.
Translation: 使用你的马卡洛夫、刀和炸药来捕获并控制所有目标。

English: Secure the area. Take all objectives and hold them. Make do with fewer supply points.
Translation: 确保该区域安全。采取并坚持所有目标。凑合使用较少的补给点。

English: Secure the area. Take all objectives and hold them on snowy mountain map Hillside.
Translation: 确保该区域安全。采取所有目标并将它们放在雪山地图 Hillside 上。

English: Secure the area. Take all objectives and hold them using shotguns.
Translation: 确保该区域安全。拿起所有目标并用霰弹枪控制它们。

English: Fast high-intensity conflict. Fight for one objective at a time. Attackers advance through the map while defenders try to stop them.
Translation: 快速高强度的冲突。一次为一个目标而奋斗。攻击者在地图上前进，而防御者则试图阻止他们。

English: Capture all enemy objectives and destroy the enemy weapon cache objective to win.
Translation: 占领所有敌方目标并摧毁敌方武器储藏目标即可获胜。

English: Open combat with drivable vehicles. Capture and defend all objectives.
Translation: 与可驾驶车辆进行公开战斗。占领并保卫所有目标。

English: Kill the enemy more than they kill you with whatever weapons you like.
Translation: 用你喜欢的任何武器杀死敌人比他们杀死你还要多。

English: Kill the enemy more than they kill you with whatever weapons you like. Steal health when you deal damage.
Translation: 用你喜欢的任何武器杀死敌人比他们杀死你还要多。当你造成伤害时窃取生命值。

English: Fight with a bolt-action Welrod pistol.
Translation: 使用栓动韦尔罗德手枪进行战斗。

English: Frenzy enemy squads come from the Frenzy mutator, which this preset enables.
Translation: 疯狂的敌方小队来自疯狂变异器，此预设启用了该变异器。

English: Movement speed x0.60 and hardcore animations come from the Hardcore mutator.
Translation: 移动速度 x0.60 和硬核动画来自硬核变异器。
